models.name: todo_app_users
models.description:
User accounts with email/password credentials, verification status, and display name. Serves as the primary identity record for all authentication flows and permission structures. All business operations related to user accounts originate from this model.

Key relationships:
- Governed by session table: todo_app_user_sessions
- Manages password reset tokens via: todo_app_user_password_resets
- Handles email verification via: todo_app_user_email_verifications
- User-owned todos tracked through: todo_app_todos table

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Registered email address used for account identification. Must be unique across all user accounts.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password representation. Never stores plaintext passwords.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: User's customizable display name visible to other users. Max 30 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when user profile was last modified.

models.name: todo_app_user_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens with access and refresh capabilities for authenticated user sessions.

foreignFields.name: todo_app_user_id
foreignFields.description: The user associated with this session.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address used during login.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current URL of the session.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL for the session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation time.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration time.

models.name: todo_app_user_password_resets
models.description: Password reset tokens with 15-minute expiration and usage tracking.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: The user associated with this password reset token. {@link todo_app_users.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: The unique password reset token for user account restoration.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp in UTC. Valid for 15 minutes from token creation.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the reset token was used to successfully update the password.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was last updated (e.g., expiry reset).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this password reset record was soft deleted.

models.name: todo_app_user_email_verifications
models.description: Email verification tokens with expiration for registration completion.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: User who requested email verification. {@link todo_app_users.id}

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token for email validation.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp of the verification token.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of token creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update to the token record.

models.name: todo_app_histories
models.description: Audit log of all todos' edit history, capturing field changes including title, description, start date, and due date. Each history entry references the corresponding todo and stores the timestamp of the edit. Maintains temporal data including creation and update times, with optional soft deletion support for the history entry itself.

foreignFields.name: todos_id
foreignFields.description: The todo this history entry belongs to. {@link todo_app_todos.id}

plainFields.name: timestamp
plainFields.description: The timestamp of when the edit event occurred.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Previous value of the title field before edit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Previous value of the description field before edit.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Previous value of the start date field before edit.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Previous value of the due date field before edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the history entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to the history entry.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the history entry was soft-deleted (if applicable).

models.name: todo_app_todos
models.description:
User-owned todo records with title, status, dates, and soft-delete tracking.

This table represents the core business entity for todo management, allowing users to create, filter, sort, and manage their todos with full soft-delete support. All todos are bound to a single user via user_id foreign key. The table maintains historical state through soft-deletion and is intended for independent CRUD operations via API endpoints.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Todo title (up to 150 characters)

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Todo description (optional)

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Start date for the todo

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Due date for the todo

plainFields.name: is_complete
plainFields.description: Completion status (default false)

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp (null for active records)
